headword: {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}

definitions.explanation: An electronic gate at train stations that reads tickets or IC cards to allow passengers through. A ubiquitous feature of Japanese public transportation.

examples.japanese: {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かざす→かざす：28115_kazasu⟧。
examples.english: To tap a card on the automatic ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please insert your ticket into the automatic ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ICカード⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなくて→足りる：01209_tariru⟧、{自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|と}められた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I was stopped at the ticket gate because my IC card didn't have enough balance.

notes:
{自動改札機|じどうかいさつき} is composed of ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧ (automatic) + ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧ (ticket inspection) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass through the ticket gate
- {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦タッチ→タッチ：08915_tacchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to touch a card to the gate

USAGE: In casual conversation, often shortened to ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧. Japanese ticket gates accept both paper tickets (inserted into a slot) and IC cards like Suica and PASMO (tapped on a sensor).
